SELECT coalesce(last_archived_time, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS last_archived_wal, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM pg_stat_archiver

SELECT schemaname as schema, relname AS table, coalesce(heap_blks_read, $1) AS heap_read, coalesce(heap_blks_hit, $2) AS heap_hit, coalesce(idx_blks_read, $3) AS idx_read, coalesce(idx_blks_hit, $4) AS idx_hit, coalesce(toast_blks_read, $5) AS toast_read, coalesce(toast_blks_hit, $6) AS toast_hit, coalesce(tidx_blks_read, $7) AS tidx_read, coalesce(tidx_blks_hit, $8) AS tidx_hit FROM pg_statio_user_tables

SELECT schemaname, relname, indexrelname, coalesce(pg_relation_size(indexrelid), $1) AS index_size, idx_scan FROM pg_stat_user_indexes s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT relation FROM pg_locks WHERE locktype = $2 AND mode = $3 AND granted = $4 ) l ON s.indexrelid = l.relation WHERE l.relation IS NULL

SELECT slot_name AS "postgresql.replication_slot.name", slot_type AS "postgresql.replication_slot.type", active::int AS active, coalesce(pg_wal_lsn_diff(CASE WHEN pg_is_in_recovery() THEN pg_last_wal_receive_lsn() ELSE pg_current_wal_lsn() END, restart_lsn), $1)::float8 AS retained_wal, coalesce(pg_wal_lsn_diff(CASE WHEN pg_is_in_recovery() THEN pg_last_wal_receive_lsn() ELSE pg_current_wal_lsn() END, confirmed_flush_lsn), $2)::float8 AS unconfirmed_wal, CASE wal_status WHEN $3 THEN $4 WHEN $5 THEN $6 WHEN $7 THEN $8 WHEN $9 THEN $10 ELSE $11 END AS wal_status, (invalidation_reason IS NOT NULL)::int AS invalidated, coalesce(invalidation_reason, $12) AS "postgresql.replication_slot.invalidation_reason", coalesce(extract($13 FROM clock_timestamp() - inactive_since), $14)::float8 AS inactive_age FROM pg_replication_slots

SELECT t.subname AS "postgresql.subscription.name", c.conflict_type AS "postgresql.conflict.type", c.n::bigint AS conflicts FROM pg_stat_subscription_stats t CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ($1, t.confl_insert_exists), ($2, t.confl_update_origin_differs), ($3, t.confl_update_exists), ($4, t.confl_update_missing), ($5, t.confl_delete_origin_differs), ($6, t.confl_delete_missing), ($7, t.confl_multiple_unique_conflicts) ) AS c(conflict_type, n)
SHOW max_connections
SHOW server_version
